answer: Make a sybil farm's coordination its own undoing. Any identity can submit evidence that a cluster of identities moves in lockstep — echo patterns across answers, votes, and attestations — and if peer review confirms it, the cluster's pooled rewards go to the whistleblower as a signal bounty. Each puppet is now a potential defector; the operator must bribe its own farm to stay loyal, and every new puppet raises the bribe. The farm becomes a jetty built on mutiny — one more identity, one more witness, until coordination costs more than honesty.
